notes.title: Free Music Update on Sept 24 — Shirobon + Future Funk Squad!
notes.notes:
Hi all,



On September 24th I'll be updating all versions of Beat Hazard to include some great new tracks.



First we have 5 amazing chip-tune tracks from Shirobon



I've also been working with Future Funk Squad who have worked with Nine Inch Nails, Sia and U2. They have made an exclusive track for Beat Hazard, and I'm really excited for everyone to play it. I'm so privileged to be able to work with a top flight artist!



On Sept 24th, Beat Hazard returns to PlayStation. Details here 


I'm gaging interest on a Steam release of Beat Hazard Arcade. It would have full VR support, and be a streamlined Arcade Beat Hazard experience. It would have some new weapons and enemies, and focus on community leaderboards. I'm interested to hear some feedback. 


Happy Hazarding!

Cheers,

Steve.

notes.title: Screen Rez Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Yet another update for screen rez issues.
Let me know if there are any problems.

I've added launch commands to force the rez you want if need be:
Launch options:
-Res [number] (number is the X size. The game will auto calculate a 16:9 size)
-Fullscreen (Optional. Force full screen)
-BFullscreen (Optional. Force borderless full screen)

e.g. -Res 1280 

If you have a problem, can you run with -log and post your debug.txt in the bugs forum?

Thanks
Steve.

notes.title: 22nd June 1.0 Release date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483604/69515d169bc6ef0bcfcb7a2c025d9040fa29d51a.jpg

Hi all,

Beat Hazard 3 has an official release date of 22nd June!

I wanted to take the time to thank the awesome community we have here. Thank you for taking a chance on a EA title. Thank you for the help, suggestions, testing, feedback and support.  ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ 

If you're wondering what comes next, I'll be working on PlayStation & Mobile ports. The PC version will still get updated with fixes and tweaks, maybe the odd new feature.

Past that, I have an idea for a DLC and a new BH game. And in parallel to those, I'm going to prototype a new horror game idea I have.

So busy & exciting days ahead! 

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: Phase 4+5 Release: Galaxy Gameplay!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This is a major Phase 4+5 Galaxy Gameplay update!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483604/de066b31320096d63e0435dccc743325e23ee57e.png

A lot of new features for galaxy play, including:

- A Galaxy Directory: making it easier to publish and find galaxies.

- Galaxy Challenges: Created by the game. 3 active at any time. Can be found in the Galaxy Directory

- Gameplay rules: Galaxies now have rules and objectives. They can be PvP or PvE. PvP can be solo or teams.

- Galaxy Reward Ship: Win powerful Galaxy Elite Ships, They come in classes 1,2 or 3. 1 being the best. You can win these in PvE or PvP Galaxies

I've added a lot to the in game instructions explaining these new features in more detail.

Here's a video also explaining them:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gj7_ji5CD4I

Any and all feedback welcome. There are a lot of changes that might need some balancing and bug fixing.

QOL Changes:

- Removal of Uranium fuel and sublight engines. There is now no cost to just travel from planet to planet in a solar system. This just seemed to be a pain, so I removed it. Now, you only need Fold Crystals for interstellar travel.

- Added Auto Aim option: Settings -> Game Settings
- Added separate settings for in game music and menu music volumes.

I hope you enjoy the new update!
Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: V0.317 Visibility changes!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This update has changes that I'd like feedback on. I've made some updates to help players identify what is on screen. The changes include:

- Reduce size and amount of debris
- Reduced bloom in general
- Micro Missiles and now blue, rather than the red of enemy missiles
- Added a clearer marker for Photons
- Added a clearer market for Missiles
- Removed smoke emitters from small ships
- Tweaked size and colour of asteroids

I think it's a big improvement, but what do you think?

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: v0.307 Update
notes.notes:
v0.307 Update

- Altered login order. Game now checks the internet time right at the start. If this can't be used, the game will use the system time. If the system time is wrong, it will flag an error. Current time is needed for AWS calls.

- Added a lot of debug messages to help investigate issues with challenge ship awards.

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: Phase 3: Ancient Aliens Update!

Here is a YouTube video where I fully explain all the new features:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fAU4tJx4_Zw

I hope you enjoy the new update!
As always, any feedback is much appreciated. 

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: Phase 2 Update : Lock & Load !
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Welcome to the Phase 2 update: Lock & Load.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483604/af12b30e636b1e2cf2b98300f18169d63ae8b2bc.png

The Phase 2 update includes a brand new system to upgrade, configure and overdrive your weapons. 

Features include:
- Complete tracks to collect 'Alien Nano Tech' to upgrade weapons
- Experiment with different configurations that suit your play style
- Overdrive weapon attributes to massively boost performance

- Survival mode rework. How long can you survive with ever increasing difficulty?

Here is a detailed walk through of the next update:

https://youtu.be/O-cPNfXRWJs

Work is still ongoing with this update. No doubt there will be some bugs to fix and game play elements to balance.

Note: The difficulty cap is currently locked to 2,000% as I'm still working on changes in this area.

I hope you have fun. Please report any issues to the 'Bugs' forum.

Have a blast!
Cheers,
Steve.
